subject: Plan to scale — commit & QBR invite
messages:
From: Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.com>
To: Anna Li <anna@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Plan to scale — commit & QBR invite

Anna — thanks again for the time last week. I wanted to start a concise thread to align on the renewal+upsell path so we can lock capacity and calendar time quickly. High-level ask from BrightLayer: add 2.5x throughput (equivalent to ~4 dedicated slots in our Dedicated pool) and move to a 12‑month committed term starting Jan 1, 2028.

Proposed next steps (short):
- Confirm uplift quantity + target date (you mentioned Feb for peak usage).
- Finalize pricing amendment and send to procurement (we can draft).
- Book a QBR to review traffic patterns, autoscale settings, and ramp plan.

I'll attach a first-pass mutual action plan (BrightLayer-MAP-v1.xlsx) and a one‑page term amendment/statement outline for legal. Can you confirm: 1) the final uplift number (is 4 dedicated slots accurate?), 2) procurement contact to loop in, and 3) which of these QBR windows works for your execs: Nov 15 (AM PST), Nov 17 (PM PST), or Nov 29 (anytime PST)?

If that sounds right I'll: draft the pricing amendment, kick off a short legal review with David, and send a calendar invite once we pick a slot.

Thanks — Elliot

--
Elliot Price
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
elliot@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 07 Nov 2027 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Plan to scale — commit & QBR invite

Elliot — quick internal note before we send to BrightLayer:
- Pricing: if they're moving to a 12mo commit and +4 dedicated slots, we'll tier them into the Reserved+ bundle (20% on per-token base + capacity discount). I'll draft numbers but want David to eyeball the SOW language.
- Capacity: confirm whether the 4 slots are contiguous (same pool) or spread across regions — affects autoscale config.
- Ops/Onboarding: recommend a short runbook call (30m) the week before the QBR so SRE can pre-warm KV cache and set prefix caching rules.

Proposed internal owners:
- Elliot: commercial lead / pricing
- Monica: onboarding runbook + ops checklist
- Grace: exec QBR present and roadmap alignment
- David: legal review (terms amendment)

I'll attach a short SOW outline (BL-SOW-Outline.docx) and a redline template for the terms amendment. Elliot — if you want me to reach out to procurement directly once Anna replies, I can.

Monica

Thanks Elliot — this looks great and aligned with our internal ask. Quick clarifications: 1) The 4 dedicated slots are correct for our expected Feb peak, but please size pricing to also include a +10% buffer in case we need two short bursts in March. 2) Procurement contact is procurement@brightlayer.com (looped). 3) Best QBR window is Nov 17 (afternoon PST) — Samuel will join for the capacity plan and I will bring our product lead.

I attached a short outline of the technical requirements our infra team expects (BL-SOW-Outline.docx). We'll need the runbook call you mentioned — suggest Nov 16 (30m) to align SRE and enable pre-warm steps.

Also, procurement asked if you can share a draft term amendment + a preliminary PO estimate by EOD Nov 10 so they can start internal approvals.

Appreciate the speed — Anna

--

Perfect — thanks for the quick reply Anna. Confirming action items and owners: 

1) Pricing + draft term amendment (Elliot) — I'll circulate a redline and preliminary PO estimate by EOD Nov 10.
2) Runbook call (Monica) — Monica will schedule a 30m runbook on Nov 16 to align SRE pre-warm steps.
3) QBR (Elliot + Grace) — scheduled for Nov 17, 2:00pm PST. I'll send an invite to this thread and include an agenda: traffic trends, autoscale settings, KV cache strategy, and rollout milestones toward Feb peak.
4) Legal review (David) — David, we'll ping you once the amendment is uploaded (DocuSign link will follow).

Attachments I just uploaded for this thread: Terms-Amendment-DL-48729.pdf (draft), BrightLayer-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones). DocuSign draft and HubSpot deal record are in the related links.

If procurement needs a PO template from our side let me know and I can attach. Looking forward to the runbook and QBR — will follow up with the calendar invites shortly.

Thanks — Elliot
